market_wrap.text: Nifty ended 0.18% higher at 25,299 after a choppy, range-bound day. Mid caps (+0.85%) and small caps (+1.12%) did better than large caps, realty led the sectors, and auto, FMCG and IT slipped. Gold and silver futures fell on MCX.

reasons.reason: Silver fell about 1.6% on MCX as markets prepared for another US Federal Reserve rate increase; higher interest rates make metals that pay no interest less attractive.
Gold futures fell about 1.2% on MCX on the same expectation of higher US interest rates.
Mid caps rallied today (Nifty Midcap 100 +0.85%) and this fund rose more than the index; no fund-specific news.
September-quarter results approved on 11 Nov: revenue up 63.7% and profit up about 182% from a year earlier, helped by record copper prices.
Reported September-quarter results today: revenue up 41.9% to ₹458.9 crore and profit up 51.8% to ₹80.8 crore from a year earlier.

news.headline: September-quarter profit up 52%
news.summary: Revenue rose 41.9% to ₹458.9 crore and profit 51.8% to ₹80.8 crore from a year earlier.

news.headline: Profit nearly triples on record copper prices
news.summary: September-quarter revenue rose 63.7% from a year earlier and profit about 182%, as copper set repeated record highs during the quarter.

news.headline: Profit slips despite higher sales
news.summary: Revenue rose 5.1% to ₹26.8 crore but profit fell 3.6% to ₹6.4 crore, so margins narrowed; revenue was also lower than the previous quarter.

news.headline: Revenue up 12.5%; ITC Infotech combination on track
news.summary: Quarterly revenue reached ₹645 crore and the company kept its 12.5% growth guidance for the year. It says the planned combination with ITC Infotech is progressing as planned.

news.headline: Revenue and profit roughly double
news.summary: September-quarter revenue rose 110% to ₹319 crore and profit 100% to ₹36 crore from a year earlier.

news.headline: Revenue up 30%, profit up 7.5%
news.summary: Revenue grew 29.9% to ₹402 crore with a 40% operating margin, but profit grew more slowly as costs rose.

news.headline: AI systems drive a fourfold jump in revenue
news.summary: Revenue rose 336% to ₹1,323 crore and profit 335% to ₹137 crore; AI systems were 58% of revenue. The order book stood at ₹2,629 crore and the company raised ₹1,200 crore.

news.headline: RBI raises repo rate to 5.50%
news.summary: The RBI raised rates by 0.25 percentage points and changed its stance to 'calibrated tightening'. Rising rates tend to weigh on bond fund prices and on richly valued stocks.

news.headline: ₹7,000 crore plan to expand mining
news.summary: The company plans to invest ₹7,000 crore over five to six years, signed agreements with several public-sector firms, and partnered with Chile's CODELCO.

news.headline: Silver down 46% from its peak
news.summary: After a huge 2025 rally, silver fell from ₹4.39 lakh per kg to about ₹2.38 lakh by late April on a strong dollar and profit-taking. Analysts cited long-term industrial demand but expected short-term pressure from interest rates.

events.detail: Meeting runs 2–4 December. The RBI raised rates in October; another rise would weigh on your bond fund and on small and mid caps.
Companies usually report from mid-January to mid-February; results moved Manorama, Hindustan Copper and KRN this quarter.

outlook.view: Long-term views cite steady industrial demand from solar panels, electronics and EVs, but near-term prices are pressured by rising US rates and a firm dollar.
outlook.watch: The next US Fed decision and the dollar.

outlook.watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

outlook.view: AI demand is lifting hardware makers like Netweb, while IT services growth is steadier; the IT index fell 0.41% today.
Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge; its earnings move closely with the copper price.
outlook.watch: Global copper prices and the mining expansion.

outlook.view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
